_comment: child-wrap-check.py の「hand-off の手順 0 で止まった turn は本人待ちに数えない」 と「依頼元の答えを数え、 本人だけが答えられる問いは残す」 の foil の歯 (修正の一部を外した mutant で、 その部分を見る check だけが落ちるか)。

mutants.name: 手順 0 の停止を本人待ちの点から外さない
pairs:
points = [p for p in _wait_points(ev, notes) if not step0_turn(ev, p[0])]
    points = _wait_points(ev, notes)
expect_fail: step 0, no go yet → kept as waiting
step 0, no go yet: the archive guard
expect_pass: control: a later turn (no model check in it) asks the person
waited on the person, only another session answered

mutants.name: 同じ turn に claim があっても手順 0 と読む
pairs: return bool(checks) and not any(min(checks) < c <= at for c in ev["claims"])
expect_fail: control: the model check, a claim and an ask in one turn
expect_pass: step 0: the go came from the parent

mutants.name: turn の始まりを見ずに前の turn の確かめも数える
pairs: start = max((t for t in starts if t <= at), default="")
expect_fail: control: a worker that never claims (no board)
expect_pass: step 0: the go came from the parent
control: the model check, a claim and an ask in one turn

mutants.name: 掲示板の hand-off で始まった窓かを見ない
expect_fail: control: no board hand-off in the window
expect_pass: step 0: the go came from the parent
control: the model check, a claim and an ask in one turn

mutants.name: go 待ちの判定で親の message を見ない
expect_fail: step 0: the go came from the parent
expect_pass: step 0, no go yet → kept as waiting

mutants.name: 依頼元の答えを数えない
pairs:
if parent and not owner_only and any(ts > at for ts, frm in ev["peers"] if frm == parent):
        return None
expect_fail: the parent answered a question of judgment in the child's window
the parent answered a question of judgment: the archive guard
the parent's answer sent to the child's uds address
expect_pass: a question of judgment answered by another session

mutants.name: 本人だけが答えられる問いも依頼元の答えで閉じる
expect_fail: an approval ask, answered only by the parent
expect_pass: the parent answered a question of judgment in the child's window

mutants.name: 親でない session の答えも数える
expect_fail: waited on the person, only another session answered
expect_pass: waited on the person, the person answered in the child's window

mutants.name: 問いより前の依頼元の message も答えと数える
expect_fail: the parent's message before the ask does not answer it
expect_pass: the parent answered a question of judgment in the child's window
